subject: Fraud & Scams
title: What to Do If You're a Victim
description: A quick win: understand What to Do If You're a Victim.

hook.text: You discover a credit card you never opened. The bill is $8,000. Panic sets in.

buildup.text: Step one: freeze your credit at all three bureaus immediately to stop new accounts.

discovery.text: File an identity theft report at IdentityTheft.gov — it creates a recovery plan and legal documentation.

twist.text: You are not liable for fraudulent charges under federal law — but proving fraud takes effort.

climax.text: Document everything. Contact each creditor individually. Keep records of every conversation.

punchline.text: Act fast, document everything, and don't pay bills you didn't create.

quiz.question: What is the first step if you discover identity theft?
options: Freeze your credit at all three bureaus
